period_note: Unaudited interim financial performance, Jan-Mar 2020 (Q1). Sourced from a DSE (dsebd.org) company-page table titled 'Interim Financial Performance: 2020', recovered via a Wayback Machine capture from 2021-06-10 (DSE's live page only ever shows the CURRENT interim year's table, rolling over once the prior year's annual report is finalized - as of June 2021 it still showed 2020, meaning FY2020's annual results had not yet been finalized at that point). This table is DSE's own compiled EPS/profit/price summary, not the bank's full quarterly financial statements (no balance sheet, deposits, or loan figures) - the bank's own site (rupalibank.com.bd) remains Cloudflare-blocked and no interim PDF filing was independently recoverable this session. Reporting basis is presumed Solo/separate (consistent with this bank's established annual-series basis and standard Bangladeshi-bank interim filing practice) but is NOT explicitly labeled solo vs consolidated on the DSE page itself - flagged as an assumption, not a confirmed fact. 'Profit from continuing operations', 'Profit for the period', and 'Total Comprehensive Income for the period' are identical in the source table (no discontinued operations, zero OCI) - only 'Profit for the period' is recorded below to avoid redundant duplicate line items. The 'Turnover/Revenue (mn)' row is DSE's generic cross-sector template label; its value is negative for this bank in every quarter recovered this session (2020-2021), which is unusual for a literal 'turnover' figure - it most likely reflects a net interest/revenue concept specific to how DSE's system captures a bank's top-line, but this dataset does not have independent confirmation of the exact definition, so it is recorded as reported under a deliberately generic normalised name rather than being mapped to a specific concept like net_interest_income without evidence.
